ex.en: He broke his wrist climbing rocks for a cigarette ad.
ex.cn: 他为了一个香烟广告攀岩折断了手腕。

tr.en: an enclosed area next to a building or group of buildings, used for a special purpose, activity, or business

ex.en: a builder’s yard
ex.cn: 建筑工地

tr.en: to open your mouth wide and breathe in deeply because you are tired or bored
an act of yawning

ex.en: Alan stretched and yawned.
ex.cn: 艾伦伸伸懒腰，打了个呵欠。

rem: 躺在草地(lawn)上伸懒腰、 打呵欠(yawn)

tr.en: happening or appearing every year or once a year
Yearly is also an adverb

ex.en: Salary levels are reviewed on a yearly basis.
ex.cn: 工资水平每年都要审查。

rex.en: ...yearly new-car sales have fallen from 7...

tr.en: to produce a result, answer, or piece of information
the amount of profits, crops etc that something produces

ex.en: Our research has only recently begun to yield important results.
ex.cn: 直到最近我们的研究才开始取得重要成果。

rex.en: ...But what did Carnegie-Mellon yield in Pittsburgh...

ph.cn: 屈服强度；屈变力；抗屈强度

rem: 这片田地(field)盛产(yield)西瓜

tr.en: the period of time when someone is young, especially the period when someone is a teenager

ex.en: Despite his youth, he had travelled alone.
ex.cn: 他虽然年纪还小，却已独自旅行过了。

rex.en: ...It’s the stage in the middle of the journey when people feel youth vanishing...

ph.cn: 青年招待所；青年（学生）宿舍

tr.en: a large area that is different from other areas around it in some way

ex.en: San Francisco and Tokyo are both located in earthquake zones.
ex.cn: 旧金山和东京都位于地震带。

ph.cn: 经济特区；经济圈；经济地带

rem: z(看作zoo， 动物园) ＋ one → 一个动物园的范围 → 范围； 参考： 动感地带M-zone
